definitions.explanation: The position facing someone or something; the forward direction.
A previous time in the past.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}の{前|まえ}で{待|ま}っています。
examples.english: I'll wait in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {三年|さんねん}{前|まえ}に{日本|にほん}に{来|き}ました。
examples.english: I came to Japan three years ago.

notes: 前 indicates position (in front) and time (before/ago). The opposite for position is 後ろ (ushiro, behind) and for time is 後 (ato, after). Common patterns: 〜の前に (in front of), 〜前 (~ ago).
